summary: @servicetitan/onboarding-ui preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs` that downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ into a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to run a sibling file `math_init.js` located in the package directory. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB heavily obfuscated bundle (string-array cipher with rotated index table, `_0x...` identifier scheme, char-code decoders) that is never referenced by the package's `main` or public API and whose name is unrelated to the declared React onboarding UI purpose. The alternate-runtime delivery routes execution around Node-based install-time scanners; on `npm install`, the obfuscated payload runs with the installing user's privileges. Fetching an alternate runtime to execute an unadvertised, obfuscated sibling script is not consistent with the package's stated purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
